Original User Story: I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner, so that I can earn that designation.

As an aspiring Scrum professional, I aim to finalize my application for the Certified Scrum Practitioner credential to enhance my career opportunities and professional growth.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully complete and submit the application form with all necessary details
- Receive a confirmation notification indicating successful application submission
- Attain the certification after fulfilling all required criteria

- Check for a confirmation email or notification following the submission
